entities.name: Tersa Lightshatter
entities.description: An orc of the Mardu Horde, younger cousin of Zurgo and a skilled stormsinger who reflected Kolaghan's lightning strike and created the Lightning Proving.

entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: Orc-led horde of Tarkir that fights Kolaghan.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: Dragon whose overwhelming lightning strike Tersa reflected.

entities.name: Lightning Proving
entities.description: Ceremony Tersa created to test young warriors.

events.summary: Tersa sneaks into the Mardu armies to fight Kolaghan using her stormsinging.
events.quote: Tersa snuck into the ranks of the Mardu armies to fight against Kolaghan

events.summary: Tersa reflects an overwhelmingly powerful lightning strike from Kolaghan that would have killed hundreds.
events.quote: she reflected an overwhelmingly powerful lightning strike from Kolaghan herself

events.summary: The new khan grants Tersa a title and she creates the Lightning Proving ceremonies.
events.quote: the new khan granted her a title
